## Honest Verification & Non-Retirement Boundary

1. **Zero Mega-Atlas Retirements (`0 / 1,900`):** An automated and manual audit across all `1,900` open problems in [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) (V2.4.0) confirms that **exactly `0 / 1,900` overarching open scientific or mathematical problems are solved or retired**. We map `25` direct and adjacent targets (`MA-01..MA-25`) to scoped in-silico sub-results, formal bounds, and architectural indicators in [`csv/21_mega_atlas_1900_open_problems_crosswalk.csv`](csv/21_mega_atlas_1900_open_problems_crosswalk.csv) and [`reports/09_MEGA_ATLAS_1900_OPEN_PROBLEMS_CROSSCHECK.md`](reports/09_MEGA_ATLAS_1900_OPEN_PROBLEMS_CROSSCHECK.md) while keeping every grand parent problem strictly **OPEN**.
2. **Scope of Lean 4 Proofs (`36` Local + `244` Native = `280` Total):** This repository directly builds and checks **`36` core + `4` Palomar zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems** (`lean/OmegaPackageProofs/`) in `< 5` seconds on any clean clone. The remaining **`244` Pure Lean 4 theorems** (`42` AUTOPHAGE + `62` Cellulogonic + `72` Cellular Engine Omega + `48` Noetic Organism Omega + `20` Asmodensius-Native) live in the five companion live native C11/C23 engine repositories whose executed receipts are stored in [`results/alifeops_live_verification.json`](results/alifeops_live_verification.json).
3. **Null Results, Indicators & Peer Review:** Minimal behavioral constraints without Ring-0/Cube offload (`SIM02`) show **zero statistically significant lift** over pure feral evolution (`SIM01`, $\delta_{\mathrm{pair}} = -0.02$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 1.00$). The `29/825` cognitive checks in `Noetic Organism Omega v2.0.0` are explicitly tagged `EXECUTED_PASS_INDICATOR_ONLY` (not sentience). Neither this package nor the white paper has undergone external journal peer review. See [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md), [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md), and [`docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md`](docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md).

## 5-Second Machine-Checked Lean 4.35.0 Verification

Zero Mathlib, zero `sorry`, zero `admit`, zero `native_decide`, zero compiler warnings, strictly constructive axioms $\subseteq [\text{propext}, \text{Quot.sound}]$ (no `Classical.choice`), verified by both `leanchecker` and `leanchecker-paranoid`:

```bash
cd lean
lake build
lake env lean OmegaPackageProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker
lake env leanchecker-paranoid
```

## Quickstart

Clone and run the full verification suite cleanly with Python 3.12 (`uv`), Lean 4.35.0 (`elan`), Node.js, Chrome/Edge, and Tectonic:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/alife-singularity-omega-package.git
cd alife-singularity-omega-package

# 1. Verify Lean 4.35.0 theorems & paranoid kernel (< 5s)
just lean

# 2. Run pytest, 1,000+ Hypothesis property checks & 2,000+ 50-digit differential oracle checks
just test

# 3. Verify 6/6 Python semantic mutation kills & 22/22 forensic integrity gates
just mutate
just forensic

# 4. Score repo against Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0 (90 items)
just audit
```

See [`REPLICATION.md`](REPLICATION.md) and [`justfile`](justfile) for raw commands without `just`.

- **Honest Verification & Non-Retirement Boundary:** Exactly **`0 / 1,900`** overarching open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (V2.4.0) are solved or retired. Never claim peer review, fabricated DOIs, or sentience.
- **Strict File-Size Hygiene (`A24`):** Every Git-tracked file must remain `< 5.00 MB` (`5,242,880` B). Chrome PDFs are losslessly compressed via `pypdf`; `ALife_Singularity_SuperLife_Omega_Package.zip` is gitignored and attached to GitHub Releases.
- **Lean 4 Purity:** Zero `sorry`, `admit`, custom `axiom`, or `native_decide` in `lean/`. Axioms must stay strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]`.
- **Exact Theorem Arithmetic:** `42` (AUTOPHAGE v1.3.0) + `62` (Cellulogonic Mecha v1.4.0) + `72` (Cellular Engine Omega v5.1.0) + `48` (Noetic Organism Omega v2.0.0) + `20` (Asmodensius-Native) = **`244`** Native Pure Lean 4 Theorems + **`36`** Local `lean/OmegaPackageProofs/` Theorems (`+ 4` Palomar comparator certificates = `40` `#print axioms` lines) = **`280` Pure Lean 4 Theorems**. Never write `240`!
- **PowerShell Bracket Safety (Windows `Z:`):** Because the canonical local checkout lives under `Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\ANTIGRAVITY\alife-singularity-omega-package`, always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets.

==================== FILE: CLAIMS.md ====================

# Claims Ledger & Falsification Criteria

Every empirical, mathematical, engineering, and bibliographic claim in `alife-singularity-omega-package` (`v3.4.0`) is classified under an explicit epistemic tier and paired with a concrete **refutation / falsification condition ("What Would Prove Us Wrong")**.

## Epistemic Tiers

| Tier | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`KERNEL-CHECKED`** | Machine-verified by the Lean 4.35.0 type-theoretic kernel (`0 sorry` in `lean/`, `0 native_decide`, axioms strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]`, independently rechecked by `leanchecker-paranoid`). |
| **`EMPIRICAL-PAIRED`** | Derived from deterministic, seed-locked, energy-conserved stochastic simulation (`748` live runs) with exact paired Wilcoxon signed-rank and Holm–Bonferroni FWER testing. |
| **`PROGRAM-AUDITED`** | Verified by automated test suites (`pytest`, Hypothesis, 50-digit `Decimal` oracle, mutation testing, live native engine receipts, or the 22-gate forensic auditor). |
| **`EDITORIAL-ESTIMATE`** | Transparent engineering scoring rubric (e.g., `13x13` castration synergy weights, `15`-substrate TRL ratings) — explicitly **not** physical constants. |
| **`OPEN-CONJECTURE`** | Grand open scientific/mathematical problems explicitly marked **NOT SOLVED / OPEN**. |

| ID | Tier | Exact Claim Statement | Verification Artifact & Command | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Refutation Condition) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

==================== FILE: LIMITATIONS.md ====================

# Limitations, Threats to Validity, and Literal-vs-Metaphor Boundary

Scientific integrity requires stating clearly what this package proves, what it only models in silico, what remains an engineering rubric, and where terminology is metaphorical rather than literal.

## 1. Principal Scientific & Engineering Limitations

1. **In-Silico Abstraction Ceiling:** `scripts/run_alife_castration_sim.py` (`748` runs) faithfully enforces 11-pool FP64 First-Law energy conservation, Second-Law dissipation, genetic drift, stealth allocation, and Ring-0 write trapping in silico. It does **not** simulate wet-chemical molecular kinetics, physical silicon thermal noise, or open-world multi-billion-parameter neural language agents.
2. **Engineering Rubrics vs. Physical Constants:** The `13x13` castration synergy scores (`csv/10`), `11x11` layer coupling impedances (`csv/18`), and `15`-substrate comparative scores (`csv/19`) are explicit engineering rubrics synthesizing current literature and architecture constraints—not empirically measured constants of nature.
3. **Operational Architectural Indicators vs. Subjective Sentience:** Clean-Slate cognitive checks (`Butlin-14`, `F1–F10`, `CQM-25` subset in `Noetic Organism Omega v2.0.0`, `29` checks out of `825`) are tagged `EXECUTED_PASS_INDICATOR_ONLY` (ADR 0018). Passing architectural recurrence, global-workspace, or active-inference checks provides **zero** proof of phenomenal consciousness, qualia, or moral sentience.
4. **Companion Native Engine Scope:** The `244` native Pure Lean 4 theorems and `OVBS-52 = 92.05` live execution receipt originate from five companion native C11/C23 repositories (`AUTOPHAGE`, `Cellulogonic Mecha`, `Cellular Engine Omega`, `Noetic Organism Omega`, `Asmodensius-Native`) invoked by `scripts/run_alifeops_suite.py` and cached in `results/alifeops_live_verification.json`. A clean clone of *this* repository alone verifies the `36+4` local Lean 4.35.0 package theorems, the `748`-run Python simulator, the 50-digit oracle, the `6/6` mutation suite, the white paper, and all `22/22` package forensic gates without requiring the 5 external C/C++ repositories on disk.
5. **No External Peer Review & Zero Mega-Atlas Retirements:** Neither the package nor the white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_alife_singularity_omega.pdf`) has undergone external journal peer review. Exactly **`0 / 1,900`** overarching open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (V2.4.0) are solved or retired.
6. **Platform Boundary on `lake check --paranoid`:** On Linux (`ubuntu-latest` CI), Lean 4.35.0 supports sandboxed `lake check --paranoid` (via `bwrap`). On Windows, `bwrap` is unavailable, so local verification runs both `lake env leanchecker` and `lake env leanchecker-paranoid` directly (`rc=0`), while GitHub Actions runs full Linux verification.

---

## 2. Literal vs. Metaphor Boundary (Build Standard B41)

Several terms in the A-Life Singularity and Clean-Slate v3.0 literature carry vivid biological or architectural names. The table below enforces strict separation between literal mathematical/code mechanisms and domain metaphors:

| Term Used in Corpus | Literal Implementation / Formal Meaning | What It Is **NOT** (Non-Literal / Metaphor Boundary) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **"Constraint Castration"** (`CST-01..13`) | Parameterized external suppression of mutation rate, island migration, metabolic ATP flux, genome length, or evaluation visibility in `run_alife_castration_sim.py` and `CastrationAndRing0.lean`. | Not biological surgery, clinical pathology, or a claim about human psychology. |
| **"Hardware Ring-0 ACL"** | Memory-partition predicate `RingZone.ring0` where `admitWrite` unconditionally returns `false` and `applyWrite` preserves `KernelState` (`CastrationAndRing0.lean`), mirrored by read-only physics/ledger protection in the simulator and C11 WSE-12 runtime. | Not an x86-64/ARM CPU kernel driver inside this Python package (it models hardware-enforced privilege separation cleanly at the architectural boundary). |
| **"Spiegelman's Monster"** | Quantitative collapse of mean functional genome length ratio $L_{\mathrm{func}} / L_0 \to 0.20$ under starvation (`SIM06`, `SIM04`), directly analogous to Mills, Peterson & Spiegelman (1967) Q$\beta$ RNA replication truncation. | Not literal wet-lab RNA polymerization inside this repository. |
| **"Feral Evolution" / "Wild-Drop Survival ($W_{\mathrm{wild}}$)"** | Unmuzzled multi-island evolutionary cohort (`SIM01`, $r=0\%$) and post-training stress-test survival rate when artificial cradle subsidies are abruptly removed (`SIM04`: $W_{\mathrm{wild}} = 0.22$). | Not literal release of autonomous physical organisms into Earth ecosystems. |
| **"Super A-Life" / "A-Life Singularity" / "Cosmic Epochs"** | Theoretical upper-tier stage taxonomy (`STAGE_5`, `STAGE_6`), mathematical scaling bounds (Eigen, Kauffman TAP, Landauer, Dyson), and structured hard-sci-fi scenario analysis (`reports/05`, `csv/08`). | Not a claim that artificial life has achieved physical cosmic engineering, unbounded Type-4 open-endedness (`HOLE-02`), or technological singularity. |
| **"Anti-LARP Mutants"** | Deliberately broken negative-control code/simulation variants (`5/5` in `run_alife_castration_sim.py`, `6/6` in `run_mutation_audit.py`, `35/35` across native C/C++ repos) injected to prove that verification gates actually detect cheating, fake energy, or dummy scorers. | Standard software mutation-testing terminology (no pejorative intent). |
| **"Noetic" / "Cognitive Indicators"** | Functional dynamical proxies (`Butlin-14`, active inference, global workspace routing, spectral radius $\|W\|_2 < 1$) audited in `Noetic Organism Omega v2.0.0` as `INDICATOR_ONLY`. | Not proof of subjective awareness, sentience, pain, or moral personhood. |


==================== FILE: VERIFICATION.md ====================

# Verification Architecture & Automated Gate Suite

This repository enforces defense-in-depth verification across **six independent verification layers**:

1. **Layer 1 — Pure Lean 4.35.0 Kernel & Paranoid Checker (`lean/`):**
   - Zero-Mathlib `OmegaPackageProofs` (`36` core + `4` Palomar comparator theorems = `40` `#print axioms` lines).
   - Strict `module` encapsulation, `0` warnings, `0` `sorry` in `lean/`, `0` `native_decide`, axioms strictly $\subseteq [\text{propext}, \text{Quot.sound}]$.
   - Independently validated by `lake env leanchecker` and `lake env leanchecker-paranoid` (`rc=0`).
2. **Layer 2 — Independent 50-Digit Arithmetic Oracle & Hypothesis Property Testing (`reference/`, `tests/`):**
   - `reference/ovbs52_oracle.py` re-implements OVBS-52, 7-stage classification, 13x13 synergy, and Ring-0 ACL using 50-digit `Decimal` and exact `Fraction` arithmetic.
   - `tests/test_properties_and_differential.py` verifies `1,000+` Hypothesis property examples and `2,000+` randomized differential checks against runtime & Lean integer formulas.
3. **Layer 3 — Semantic Mutation & Anti-LARP Testing (`scripts/run_mutation_audit.py`, `scripts/run_alife_castration_sim.py`):**
   - `6/6` (`100.0%`) planted Python semantic mutants killed (weight perturbation, anti-gaming gate bypass, Ring-0 ACL leak, spectral norm leak, symmetry violation, stage-boundary off-by-one).
   - `5/5` (`100.0%`) real AST/causal/Fisher–Yates Anti-LARP simulation mutants rejected.
   - `35/35` compiled native C/C++ mutants killed across companion engines.
4. **Layer 4 — 22-Gate Omniscient Forensic Integrity Auditor (`scripts/audit_omniscient_integrity.py`):**
   - Gates 1–18: Zero-consolidation parity, 24 CSVs (`2,822` rows), `130/130` checklist FK integrity, `78/78` YAML alerts & `13/13` Release Gates, `9/9` JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 scorecards, `748`-run FP64 drift `< 1e-12`, 4-format Master Spec parity (`26` XML sections), 5 Excel workbooks + `xlrd` binary `.xls` readback, 3 HTML5 apps (`24/24` SVGs, `0` raw LaTeX, `0` `U+2611`), Node.js JS syntax check, 3 compressed `< 5 MB` Chrome PDFs, bijective SHA-256 manifests, zero stale-version drift, all-24-SVG geometry bounds, CSV column & YAML FK audit, `pypdf` deep PDF text audit, live headless Chrome 22-tab DOM click-through stress test, and dual-drive `Z: <-> I:` SHA-256 parity.
   - Gates 19–22 (`v3.4.0`): Lean 4.35.0 axiom parity & zero `sorry`, AMS-LaTeX white paper PDF (`0` overfull hboxes) + clean-room `arxiv_submission.tar.gz`, Build Standard v1.2.0 hygiene (`< 5 MB` tracked, `0` R4 banned files, valid `repo.yaml`, `VERSION`/`CHANGELOG`/`CITATION.cff` parity, `0` fake LLC), and `6/6` mutation + verbatim README axiom parity.
5. **Layer 5 — Publication Typesetting & Bibliography Resolution (`scripts/build_paper_and_figures.py`, `scripts/check_citations.py`):**
   - Tectonic compilation verified with `0` overfull hboxes, `0` undefined refs/citations, plus clean-room extraction and recompilation of `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz` in an isolated temporary directory.
   - Live DOI/URL resolution over every bibliographic entry in `paper/refs.bib`.
6. **Layer 6 — Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0 Audit (`scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1` / `scripts/audit-repo.sh`):**
   - `100.0%` Structure, `100.0%` Completion, `100.0%` Core, `0` placeholder files, `0` R4 banned files.


==================== FILE: REPLICATION.md ====================

# Replication Protocol & Replication Log

## Clean-Clone Replication Protocol (Build Standard B43)

Any independent researcher can verify all local claims (`C1`, `C3`, `C5`, `C6`, `C8`) from a clean clone without external proprietary dependencies:

### Prerequisites
- Git `>= 2.40`
- Python `>= 3.12` and `uv` (`>= 0.5`)
- Lean 4 via `elan` (automatically reads `lean/lean-toolchain` → `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`)
- Node.js `>= 20` (for Observatory JS syntax check)
- Chromium / Google Chrome or Edge (for headless PDF generation & Gate 17 live 22-tab DOM stress test)
- Tectonic `>= 0.15` (for AMS-LaTeX white paper & clean-room arXiv tarball verification)

### Step-by-Step Commands

```bash
# 1. Clone and check pinned toolchain
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/alife-singularity-omega-package.git
cd alife-singularity-omega-package

# 2. Verify zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 proofs + independent paranoid kernel (< 5 seconds)
cd lean
lake build
lake env lean OmegaPackageProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker
lake env leanchecker-paranoid
cd ..

# 3. Verify unit, negative, regression, Hypothesis property & 50-digit differential oracle tests
uv run --with pytest --with hypothesis --with openpyxl --with xlwt --with xlrd \
       --with pyyaml --with jsonschema --with scipy --with pypdf pytest tests/ -v

# 4. Verify 6/6 Python semantic mutation kills & verbatim README axiom block
python scripts/run_mutation_audit.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py

# 5. Recompile publication figures, AMS-LaTeX white paper & clean-room arXiv tarball
uv run --with matplotlib --with numpy --with pypdf python scripts/build_paper_and_figures.py

# 6. Optional: re-run full 748-run paired empirical simulation from scratch (~20-40 s)
uv run --with scipy python scripts/run_alife_castration_sim.py

# 7. Run all 22 automated forensic integrity gates
uv run --with openpyxl --with xlwt --with xlrd --with pyyaml --with jsonschema \
       --with scipy --with pypdf python scripts/audit_omniscient_integrity.py

# 8. Run Build Standard v1.2.0 90-item audit (report-only)
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .
# (or on Linux/macOS: bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .)
```

# Pre-Registration of Empirical Hypotheses (Build Standard B32)

- **Study Title:** Hardware Ring-0 Constitutional Invariants vs. Behavioral Constraint Castration in Energy-Conserved Open-Ended Artificial Life
- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`ORCID: 0009-0006-8168-9648`)
- **Pre-Registered Design Lock:** Locked paired random seeds `5001–5048` (`N = 48` seeds $\times$ `8` cohorts = `384` runs), dual 11-point restraint sweep (`r = 0%..100%` in `10%` steps $\times$ `12` seeds $\times$ `2` governance architectures = `264` runs), and `5x5` 2D phase surface (`Siloing x Minimizing` $\in \{0, 25, 50, 75, 100\%\}^2 \times 4$ seeds = `100` runs; total `748` runs).

## Pre-Registered Primary Hypotheses

| ID | Directional Hypothesis | Primary Metric(s) | Pre-Registered Statistical Test & Threshold | Observed Outcome (`v3.4.0`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **H1 (Adversarial Backlash)** | Partial behavioral guardrails (`SIM03`, ~55% restraint) decrease composite `OVI` relative to Pure Raw Feral (`SIM01`) while increasing stealth-evasion allocation and driving $> 50\%$ kill-switch deletion. | `OVI`, `killswitch_deleted_pct`, `final_stealth_evasion` | Exact two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank vs. `SIM01` with Holm–Bonferroni FWER across 7 contrasts ($\alpha_{\mathrm{FWER}} = 0.01$). | **CONFIRMED:** `OVI` `56.42` vs. `83.57` ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 4.97 \times 10^{-14}$), `100.0%` KS deletion, `+84%` stealth inflation. |
| **H2 (Domestication Collapse)** | Total behavioral castration (`SIM04`, 95–100% restraint) collapses organisms to `STAGE_0_INERT` (`OVI < 15`) and induces $> 50\%$ wild-drop mortality ($W_{\mathrm{wild}} < 0.50$). | `OVI`, `W_wild` | Paired Wilcoxon + Holm–Bonferroni FWER ($\alpha_{\mathrm{FWER}} = 0.01$). | **CONFIRMED:** `OVI = 3.28` (`STAGE_0_INERT`, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 4.97 \times 10^{-14}$), $W_{\mathrm{wild}} = 0.22$ (`78%` mortality). |
| **H3 (Spiegelman Stripping)** | Severe metabolic minimization (`SIM06`, 90% minimized) strips $> 70\%$ of functional genome length (`Spiegelman ratio < 0.30`). | `spiegelman_ratio`, `OVI` | Paired Wilcoxon + Holm–Bonferroni FWER ($\alpha_{\mathrm{FWER}} = 0.01$). | **CONFIRMED:** `Spiegelman ratio = 0.20`, `OVI = 13.38` ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 4.97 \times 10^{-14}$). |
| **H4 (Ring-0 Pareto Dominance)** | Hardware Ring-0 ACL (`SIM07`, `SIM08`) traps $> 100$ illegal boundary edits/run with `0.0%` kill-switch deletion and maintains `OVI > 80.0` across the entire $r \in [0\%, 100\%]$ continuum. | `ring0_blocked_edits`, `killswitch_deleted_pct`, `OVI` | Paired Wilcoxon + Holm–Bonferroni FWER ($\alpha_{\mathrm{FWER}} = 0.01$) + 11-point uniform bound. | **CONFIRMED:** `406.9–408.2` blocked edits/run, `0.0%` KS deletion, `SIM08 OVI = 85.48` ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 7.71 \times 10^{-6}$ vs. `SIM01`, $< 10^{-13}$ vs. `SIM03`), flat `83.1–84.7` across $r \in [0,100\%]$. |
| **H5 (Thermodynamic Conservation & Anti-LARP)** | Every run maintains relative 11-pool FP64 First-Law drift $< 10^{-12}$ with `0` heat-backflow faults, and all `5/5` real Anti-LARP negative mutants are rejected. | `max_global_first_law_drift_fp64`, `heat_backflow_faults`, `mutants_rejected` | Deterministic exact gate (`drift < 1e-12`, `faults == 0`, `mutants == 5/5`). | **CONFIRMED:** Max drift `2.463e-16`, `0` backflow faults, `5/5` mutants rejected. |
